clauses.title: The launch request carries no schema
requires: the schema is the gate role's own `outputSchema`

clauses.title: The read refuses a child that ran with another schema
CL-D90 records where the schema lives
clauses.section: ## CL-D90 — The gate schema lives in the gate roles' agent definitions
requires: putting a schema back in the launch request, or reading a result whose child schema differs requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: The CL-D90 fixtures drive the definitions, the launch, and the read
requires: Issue #184 every gate role carries the packaged schema in its definition
Issue #184 gate_result_read names a child that ran with a schema other than the packaged one
